name: colibri
description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
one_liner: Lets you run today's biggest AI models on an ordinary computer instead of expensive cloud servers, by cleverly shuffling parts of the model between disk, memory, and graphics card.
buyer: A small AI startup or privacy-conscious business that wants to run powerful AI models in-house without paying ongoing cloud API fees.
business_use_cases: A startup burning money on API calls switches its backend to self-hosted inference on existing hardware, cutting a major recurring cost.
A company with strict data-privacy requirements (legal, healthcare) runs frontier-scale AI entirely on-premises instead of sending data to a cloud API.
A hardware reseller bundles a 'run your own AI' workstation pre-configured with it as a product.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'self-hosted AI migration' consulting for companies trying to cut cloud AI API bills
Sell pre-configured hardware bundles optimized for running it

steal_this: This weekend, benchmark one popular model's cost on cloud APIs vs. running it locally with this on a mid-range PC, and use the savings number as a sales pitch to one API-heavy startup.
